notes.title: Asteroids ++ 1.3.1 - Speed Utility Refactor and Player Weight Removal
notes.content:
Overhauled the speed utility:
Speed utility is now available in casual difficulty, previously it was locked down due to the weight system

BUT speed no longer affects player speed, it now affects player bullets

What does that mean? Some weapons rely on player speed to deal even more damage, for instance, rockets, fireworks and mini rock pods deal damage the larger the impact is. Other bullets get other benefits, like the shotgun being able to reach further down the line.

With this change, the power star utility will be much more useful since you wont go spinning around in places and it is easier to memorize player movement and controls without dynamically changing.

This change also removes player weight functionality entirely from the game. It was annoying that you would never know what kind of player weight you had when you put a certain weapon, and it was getting increasingly harder to balance with more items, so it is removed!

Dash ability and strafing now get a speed buff depending on speed utility, which was supposed to be a thing in the first place.
Performance issues
There was an performance issue where if many asteroids were to be on top of each other, a blend effect would kick in and it was possible for hundreds of asteroids to blend colors which would cause huge lag spikes, especially for yellow asteroids. With this change I hope to reduce lags so you can destroy even more asteroids at smooth framerates.

Let me know if this change has improved the performance
Other changes
Speed utility is now significantly cheaper

Shift no longer activates abilities, as that is now for player strafing

Repair kit shotgun boost nerfed by 33%, other weapons unchanged

Also in the following updates I will continue to refactor some parts of the game to make the development a bit easier. Since the beginning I've got some bad code written down which does stagger development a bit, but even if it's not as bad I will try to improve some areas where I think the game can benefit.

notes.title: 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY
notes.content:
HAPPY FIRST YEAR ANNIVERSARY
Happy birthday Asteroids ++ ! The game was released on 20th June of 2024, how time flies doesn't it? Well it's time to reveal some next changes for the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/8a998e21862966f9b60190c7b629060215b528f7.gif"]
Breakdown
I am still seeing the player base enjoying and playing the game. I've been pushing the game to other platforms like gx.games where the game got jawdropping 70000 players playing it! And 10000 steam players have launched the game!
4th Drop
I will start doing Planet Drops again, I want to make the planet drops to be a bit more consistent, because the first drop lasted maybe 2 weeks, the second around a month or two, and this one? 9 MONTHS!

Yeah, that's right, the third drop lasted since 22nd September! I think it is finally time to do something about that, so I will try to be consistent and release **every planet drop for every 4 months.** This way the players can know when to expect new campaigns, weapons, asteroids and big updates, while in between 
1.3.0
I have been working here and there on the game, to be honest, I've been mostly on other projects, so I think I will shift some focus on the game again, here is what is coming up:
Teegarden Campaign
A campaign featuring 4 planets, with a new gimmick of 'disproportionate' planets, where you will face 3x4 planets, or 4x3. The campaign will feature Teegarden B, C and D, and the Teegarden Star, which is 5x5! It will cost 3.99€ as a DLC, but like always, you can buy planets or get planet drops to play the campaign for completely free!
The Jovian Moons
A campaign featuring 6 planets, featuring Ganymede, Callisto, Io, Europa, Amalthea, Himalia. The campaign will cost 5.99€, but you can buy planets or gather planet drops for free.
New Weapon - Fireworks
Thought it would be fitting. Basically imagine a rocket except it explodes into a bigger explosion of smaller rockets! It will deal HUGE damage, but no homing capability, and it has limited range.
New Ability - Power Star
For a temporary time, turn all of your weapons and utilities to level 12, and hear epic music while at it!

The 1.3.0 update will come out when the 4th drop gets out.
1.3.1 and beyond:Game-based campaigns/music kits
I was thinking to do this for a while, where if you owned something on the steam library, you would get a campaign or a **music kit for free.** I'm going to look into it more and this will be a cross-game event.
Changeable music
Music during gameplay are based on what asteroids you face, but I will be looking to have players customize this feature.
Difficulty Change
I will be making a drastic change for difficulty. When going from planet to planet, you lose weapons and their levels based on difficulty, but I am thinking to change it up so that instead of losing weapons, the shop items get banned per planet based on seed. I think this is a more interesting approach rather than removing something from the player that they already bought.
Weekly planet difficulty
There are players playing and competing for a new record times in weekly planet, so I will do a small update for it. You will be able to change difficulties in weekly planet and you will get bonuses.
Common Drops
Music kits, asteroid drops, weapon drops! You name it! They are all coming
Ability/Utility Crafting
I plan to add abilities and utility items for drops, which can be used as discounts for the skill tree (1% per level), just like how weapons work at the moment.



Anyways, I will be hard working to get this out as fast as possible! Tomorrow is going to be a sale on the Asteroids ++ Soundtrack, Proxima Centauri and Kepler-90 campaigns. Have fun!

notes.title: Asteroids ++ 1.1.5 - MULTI-SECTOR SELECT
notes.content:
Release 1.1.5

I would've easily called this 1.2.0, but I'm planning something much bigger, so 1.1.5 it is.
Ever had 'low attention span' playing this game? Beating Jupiter sectors 16 times sounds repetitive, which was a common complaint that it gets a bit stale after a while. So I decided to add something to counter that while adding strategic value.

Introducing Multi Sector Select!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/d44a01e55a4d20e45095fbdd081039218f7f516c.png

Multiselecting sector lets you battle multiple sectors at once! This also works with idle conquering, so you can idle conquer multiple sectors as well. There is no limit on what sectors you battle, you can conquer the entire planet by selecting all sectors!

The ultimate goal for this is to lower amount of playtime required to save the planet, but in return it makes the game harder and less rewards on average is given. Note that this feature is locked until players are at least level 15, this was intentional to not frustrate new players with information bombardment.

New Campaign - THE SUN

It's a campaign with a single planet, which is 6 x 6 size! Use multi sector to your advantage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/adab70d22e59c5c6b4860758860cc5f4bb17b496.png

You need to have the sun item in your inventory to play

WOMBO COMBO
Beat 10 or more sectors at once
SUPER SKIP PAYOUT
Gather over rewarded 1000 $$$ for super skipping

Summary


 Added the sun campaign

 Multi selecting will cause the battle room to be bigger

notes.title: ASTEROIDS ++ WILL RELEASE THIS JULY
notes.content:
Hola!
I am extremely excited to announce that Asteroids ++, my next upcoming game is coming up on July 2024. Be sure to wishlist the game to be the very first players to try the game out!

T H E   Y E A R   I S   2 4 5 0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663610/9c332073e2564d958fa2714d9881a8f9813c52ab.png

Humanity has expanded their technology and improved in Rocketry. There was nothing out of the ordinary until disaster struck!

A moon one light year away exploded and has spread asteroids all over our solar system, this is where YOU come in!

You play as one of the captains who will control one of the spaceships! Go from planet to planet and get rid of the Asteroids!

What to expect?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/af2b2c8025eadd7c86e21a35ac84088486d6f58b.png

Asteroids ++ is the best Asteroids clone you will ever play in your life.


 The game currently has 12 weapons, 6 abilities and 6 utilities, each will a skill tree that the player can use to their advantage to beat those pesky asteroids! 
 Conquer and beat sectors to gain control and save planets in your solar system!
 The game currently has two campaigns, Main Game and Pluto where players can save various planets and gather trophies! More will be added throughout updates!
 The game has steam achievements that the player can try and get by beating planets in campaigns
 The game has statistics that track the player, as well as leaderboards of how much money players have
 The game has an economy with droppable items with their own rarities and value
 [strike]The game has... lore??[/strike]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677482/168feb010c4de87e8463f79fa3ef1c3b9d41e50c.png
What is coming?
During the livespan of the game I expect to add more content and features, such as:

 Customizable Weapons (Adjust your weapon to your liking, more money spent = more powerful weapon)
 Endless Run (Compete in a leaderboard with other people)
 Campaign Editor (Make your own levels, planets and scenarios!)
 Steam Workshop Support
 Controller Support
 Local Co-OP [strike](And maybe online multiplayer)[/strike]


Keep in mind, this is a game that is free to play! So there will be upcoming DLCs (mainly OST) that support me to continue making this game.

PLEASE WISHLIST THE GAME HERE WHEN IT COMES OUT!

Thank you for your support!
